name: smwgraphics-teenage-mutant-ninja-turtles-tournament-fighters-genesis-spaceship
title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Tournament Fighters (Genesis) - Spaceship
description:
Here it is: the last tileset of the game. A fight on a spaceship. Belial ripped this. I did convert it to SMW usage. It does have the following features:

-this tileset does consume BG1, FG3, BG2, BG3 and FG2 tiles. Only the bushes, slanted pipes and gradient colors have been removed, but the rest is there.
-the FG has 170 Map16 tiles and the BG has 194 Map16 tiles.
-Bonus: BG and FG use the same palette.
-Bonus: In case you want to use the BG or FG of this tileset, you can use ExGFX files included here.
